description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

We’re looking for an IT Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems and helping people get the most out of their technology. As a primary point of contact for employee IT support, you’ll resolve everyday issues and help ensure employees have the equipment, applications, and access they need to do their best work.

Your work will span hands-on troubleshooting, employee onboarding, equipment management, and software administration. You’ll partner with IT Engineering and application owners, build helpful resources for employees, and identify ways to make support more efficient. This role offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of workplace technology and make a direct impact on the employee experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Resolve IT support requests & maintain knowledge base: Triage, prioritize, and resolve employee technology issues; document troubleshooting steps and escalate complex engineering issues while building easy-to-find user guides and support documentation.

  • Manage hardware & equipment lifecycle: Fulfill equipment requests, maintain inventory records, track refresh schedules/warranties, and coordinate repairs, procurement, and secure disposal.

  • Support employee transitions & access administration: Manage onboarding/offboarding setup, administer SaaS licenses and user permissions, and route privileged access requests to application owners.

  • Ensure audit readiness & event AV support: Maintain accurate Helpdesk records for compliance/audits and provide technical setup and troubleshooting for company meetings and events.

What We Look For

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, IT operations, or systems administration.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, operating systems, SaaS applications, user accounts, and workplace connectivity.

  • Experience using a ticketing system to prioritize requests, document steps, track issues through resolution, and create useful support documentation.

  • Service-oriented mindset with strong written/verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts to nontechnical users clearly and patiently.

  • Familiarity with employee onboarding/offboarding, account access, basic security practices, and sound judgment for escalating issues or handling sensitive data.

  • U.S. citizenship, ability to work standard PT business hours (8 a.m.–5 p.m.), and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hardware deployment, endpoint management (macOS/Windows), and IT asset lifecycle planning.

  • Experience administering SaaS platforms (such as Okta, Jira, Google Workspace, Slack), managing identity, access, MFA, and role-based permissions.

  • Experience conducting user access reviews, application audits, IT compliance activities, vendor coordination, and tracking IT expenses.

  • Experience supporting warehouse technology, conference room AV equipment, or technical needs for company events.

  • Degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field, or certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Google IT Support.


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
